readings.Aries: There's someone around you who has been trying to get a word in. Let them. The question matters more than the answer right now.
readings.Taurus: The dependable version of yourself is real. The rest of you is also real and occasionally needs air. Simpler is correct here.
readings.Gemini: Not every thought needs to be shared. Some of them are just thoughts. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.
readings.Cancer: The mood that arrived without explanation is responding to something real. What is it? Let this one be easy.
readings.Leo: Someone underestimated you recently. The most satisfying response is excellence, delivered quietly. Saying less will move this further than saying more.
readings.Virgo: There is a question about yourself that your analysis keeps circling. Land on it. What worked before will not work the same way this time.
readings.Libra: Someone is asking you to take their side. You are stalling. At some point stalling is a choice. What worked before will not work the same way this time.
readings.Scorpio: The loyalty you extend to your own past version of events — check whether those events still hold. Someone you haven't thought of lately is relevant to this.
readings.Sagittarius: The journey you're on has been lonely at points. The loneliness is not a flaw in the journey. This situation responds well to direct engagement.
readings.Capricorn: The patience you've shown is remarkable. It is not infinite. Know when you're close to the edge. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Aquarius: Your idealism is not naïveté. It is a choice. Keep choosing it, but with your eyes open. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Pisces: Something is ending and it is right for it to end and you are sad and both of those things are true. The timing is better than it feels.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
